summary: The clinic_branch_transfer_gap task exercised the same core inventory-load-planning capability but introduced two reusable patterns not yet captured: (1) transfer/booking deduplication when the same ID appears multiple times with different dates/statuses, and (2) composite grouping keys (Branch+Item) for inbound aggregation. I'm updating the existing inventory-load-planning skill to add these patterns, extend the column synonym table, and clarify the dedup-then-filter workflow order.
